programmes.t: Friars Club Roast of Ed Sullivan
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan's 10th anniversary in television roast by The Friars Club was originally broadcast November 9th, 1958, hosted by Jack Carter and featuring appearances by friends, colleagues, and notable surprise guests along the way!
The birds and the bees are a topic of conversation for Joan Rivers and Johnny notes the high price of meat these days in this episode which also features William Caulfield and Amos Caulfield.
Garry Shandling does a standup routine and inventor Joe Newman talks with Johnny.
The great Jonathan Winters returns as Carol's guest, highlighted by a dual role in "The Wonderful World Of Hospitals." And the latest "Carol & Sis" sketch finds carol stuck in Chris' space helmet.
Comic genius Robin Williams rips into Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas, and teams up with comedian Jonathan Winters for a hysterical dog and cat routine.
Rocky said, “Life is about…how many you can take.” Despite his huge successes with Rocky and Rambo, Sly Stallone has taken a lot. He talks about early struggles and his flagging career.
With five Bond movies under his belt, Sir Roger Moore says he’ll keep going. Having just won the Oscar for Reds, Maureen Stapleton wonders aloud how it will impact her career.
Jennifer Grey talks about her famous parents. And Carl Reiner talks about his friends Mel Brooks and Steve Martin, and also about....his dog Homer.
What a star-studded show!! Elizabeth Tylor and Michael Douglas join Johnny. Nuff said?!
Comedy Stars Jerry Seinfeld and Charles Grodin share loads of laughs over eyeglasses, doctor visits, and (wait for it) bowling shoes.
Guest stars Bing Crosby and Paul Lynde take a trip to Canoga Falls in tonight's "As The Stomach Turns." And on "The Old Folks", Lynde joins the elderly duo to celebrate Veteran's Day.
TV actor Emmanuel Lewis admits he watches The Tonight Show only once in a blue moon.
Carlin and Carson talk about writing a sequel to the Bible, Susan Sullivan dreams of Johnny and Sheryl Lee Ralph doesn't need a husband.
Tim Conway and The Pointer Sisters guest star! Sketches include the game show "Up Your Income", with Carol's Stella Toddler character as a contestant, and Tim as Nora Desmond's new butler.
George Miller does standup, Robert Mitchum talks about his marijuana conviction, and Dick Van Patten and stuntman Dennis Madalone appear.
Catch outrageous flirting as Angie Dickinson denies rumors about her and singer Julio Iglesias. Then she gets all sweet and cozy on Johnny. “We are not strangers,” she tells the audience.

programmes.t: Comedy Legends from The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Jackie Mason's "Ed Sullivan, LBJ"; Jan Murray's "TV Shows & Doctors"; Dody Goodman's "Men vs. Women"; Lewis and Christy's "Hinky Finky Report"
For his first appearance on The Tonight Show, Louie Anderson pays tribute to his parents and his home state, Minnesota. Also appearing is Robert Blake.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Animals, Barbara McNair, Burger's Animals, Dick Cavett, Franco Corelli, EydieGorme, and Enzo Stuarti.
Actor/Comedian Eddie Murphy shows an SNL clip in which he impersonates Bill Cosby. Shares his observation that there are no black people in Beverly Hills.
Carol's guest is Paul Sand! A pair of sketches dealing with weddings are featured, addressing the planning and aftermath of the ceremonies. Also: a series of timely bits related to the energy crisis.
Imogene Coca and "The Velvet Fog" Mel Torme are Carol's guests. Highlights include Coca and Carol as wives of rival political candidates, and a fangtastic Dracula sketch with Torme as Igor.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Bob Newhart, Dennis Weaver, Bobbi Martin, and Kay Medford.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Blood, Sweat and Tears, Leslie Uggams, The Schaller Brothers, Caterina Valente and Sylvio Francisco, Joan Rivers, and Eric Brenn.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Joan Rivers, Sally Ann Howes, Ravic and Babs, Los Indios Tabajaras, and The Young Rascals.
Oscar clubbers Michael Caine and Sean Connery share a clip from their movie The Man who would be King. Connery announces he’s retiring from James Bond movies and Caine says he’s now a wine merchant.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Engelbert Humperdinck, Lainie Kazan, Tiny Tim, David Hemmings, and Gloria Loring.
Two generations of comedy guest star in this episode--the fabulous Lucille Ball and the funny George Carlin! Lucy and Carol fly high as flight attendants, while George serves up a slice of stand-up.
Carol and company offer up a collection of delightful sketches, including Carol as an old lady feeding birds in the park, Tim as a wacky pharmacist, and Carol and Vicki as office buddies on a cruise.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tonight, Tim and Carol spar over a late-night phone call, Tim tries to sell Vicki a vacuum cleaner

programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Animals, Pompoff & Thedy, Rosemary Clooney, Tony Lama, Alan King, Gino Tonetti, and Chris Kirby.
Paul Lynde and Nanette Fabray guest on the season finale, featuring an installment of "As The Stomach Turns", and a reflection on moments past from Carol's iconic Charwoman persona.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: A 'Family Show', featuring 'The Family'! Ed is going on an out-of-town trip...but Eunice and Mickey want to come along
We’re spelling tonight! Walter Matthau and Johnny quiz one another on difficult words. Matthau recalls filming Tunisia and shows a clip from his movie, Pirates.
